reference.unit: visible punching-activity bout, not individual punch
reference.onset: first visible committed punching action; preparatory guard/defense/footwork excluded
reference.end: first excluded frame after final punch excursion/return; pauses <1/4 second remain in the bout
reference.edge_rule: clip visible support at block boundaries and mark censored; do not invent physical onset/end
reference.uncertainty: separate unknown sections; completion may retain uncertainty

primary.matching: maximum cardinality, then maximum total IoU, stable deterministic ties
primary.censored_policy: include visible support; never drop predicted censored alarms
primary.false_positive_denominator: full duration of completed clean scored blocks, including pose-abstention time
primary.latency: first source-time emission minus reference onset; only matched references with uncensored starts
primary.negative_latency: report as early alarm, not anticipation
primary.prediction_bouts: Causally group decoder events separated by <1/4 second within the same contiguous block/segment; never bridge unknown, missing/unreliable observations, cuts or resets. Keep first event onset and first emission, last event end. Finalize after the quarter-second silence or censor at boundary. No probability or threshold tuning.

policy: no held-out prediction access, threshold selection, scoring or training before complete frozen references
